decision: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
event_name: Date 20 May 2022 Time 16:48 2022 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 May 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 17 & 18) and heard from the driver of car 36 and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Impeding of Car 63 by Car 36 at turn 12.
offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 1st Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 36 (Juri Vips) and team representatives and examined video evidence. The team manager indicated that the team had provided the driver the wrong information having had a software issue. Thus the driver was following the team's advice, but was certainly driving slowly on the racing line and forced car 63 to take evasive action thereby unnecessarily impeding.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 36 Impeding
